title: Five checks before you launch.

slides.title: Know the goal.
slides.body: One sentence: what should a visitor do after reading the page? Everything else follows from it.

slides.title: Measure first.
slides.body: Install analytics and a form-submit event before launch, not after the first campaign.

slides.title: Test on a phone.
slides.body: Most visits are mobile. Open the page on a real phone on mobile data, not on office Wi-Fi.

caption: Five checks to run before you launch a site.
